description: The first CLI and MCP server for MotoGP — human-friendly commands, offline SQLite history, and analyses no single endpoint provides.

tools.name: broadcast-categories_list
tools.description: List broadcast categories for a season year. Required: seasonYear. Returns array of Category.

tools.name: broadcast-events_get
tools.description: Get a single broadcast event by ID. Required: id. Returns the BroadcastEvent.

tools.name: broadcast-events_list
tools.description: List broadcast events (schedules, circuits) for a season year. Required: seasonYear. Returns array of BroadcastEvent.

tools.name: categories_list
tools.description: List categories for a season (--season-uuid) or event (--event-uuid). Optional: seasonUuid, eventUuid. Returns array of Category.

tools.name: classification_get
tools.description: Get the classification/results for a session. Required: id. Optional: seasonYear, is-test. Returns the Classification.

params.name: is-test
params.description: Whether this is a test session

tools.name: events_list
tools.description: List events for a season (pass --season-uuid; see 'seasons list' for UUIDs). Required: seasonUuid. Optional: isFinished. Returns array of Event.

tools.name: grid_get
tools.description: Get grid positions and qualifying times. Required: event-id, category-id. Returns the Grid.

tools.name: riders_get
tools.description: Get a single rider profile and career history. Required: id. Returns the Rider.

tools.name: riders_list
tools.description: List all riders across categories for the current season. Returns array of Rider.

tools.name: riders_statistics
tools.description: Season-by-season rider statistics. Required: legacy-id. Returns the RiderStatistics.

params.name: legacy-id
params.description: Rider legacy ID (e.g. 7444 for Marc Marquez)

tools.name: riders_stats
tools.description: Career statistics (wins, podiums, poles, etc.). Required: legacy-id. Returns the RiderStats.

params.name: legacy-id
params.description: Rider legacy ID (e.g. 7444 for Marc Marquez)

tools.name: seasons_list
tools.description: List all MotoGP seasons with year and current flag. Returns array of Season.

tools.name: sessions_get
tools.description: Get a single session by ID. Required: id. Returns the Session.

tools.name: sessions_list
tools.description: List sessions for an event and category. Required: eventUuid, categoryUuid. Returns array of Session.

tools.name: standings_bmwaward
tools.description: BMW Award (pole/qualifying) standings for a season. Required: seasonUuid. Returns the Standings.

tools.name: standings_files
tools.description: Official standings document (PDF) URLs. Required: seasonUuid, categoryUuid. Returns the StandingsFiles.

tools.name: standings_list
tools.description: Championship standings for a season and category. Required: seasonUuid, categoryUuid. Returns the Standings.

tools.name: teams_list
tools.description: List teams with rosters for a category and season year (use broadcast category UUIDs from 'broadcast-categories list'). Required: categoryUuid, seasonYear. Returns array of Team.
